methods.scenarios: User-supplied finite deterministic offsets; no probability model or random sampling
methods.relative_span: 100*(maximum-minimum)/abs(nominal); zero denominator is null; incomplete coverage is null
methods.score: Weighted utility clamped to [0,1] using fixed nominal candidate min/max; numerically constant nominal response utility=0.5
methods.constant_metric: Nominal span <= 16*machine epsilon*max(abs(min),abs(max)); no unit-sized absolute floor
methods.ties: Absolute score tolerance 1e-12; descending groups anchored to each group highest score; average ranks
methods.spearman: Pearson correlation of tie-aware average ranks; constant rank vector returns null
methods.top_share: Equal credit among tied leaders in each supplied scenario; averaged per preference; selected-scenario shares, not probabilities
methods.unsupported: All records retained; any unsupported candidate/scenario suppresses every complete global ranking

scope: Finite scenario sensitivity of frozen surrogate means. Not model uncertainty, a robustness guarantee, physical validation, or recalculated background LCA.
